aboutH2: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres: Treating Addictions and Co-Occurring Disorders
intro: At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they take a comprehensive approach to treating substance and process addiction, mental health conditions, and co-occurring disorders. Their experienced masters-level therapists lead both group and individual therapy sessions, tailored to each client’s unique needs. Clients receive three individual therapy sessions per week, along with a variety of group therapy sessions and workshops.

They offer residential treatment programs of 42 days or longer, along with a virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP). Before beginning treatment, clients receive a psychiatric assessment to determine the best program for their specific needs. During treatment, they have access to addiction counsellors 24/7, along with a range of wellness options to support their recovery journey.

pillars.title: Addiction Treatment Programs at Trafalgar: Hope and Healing
pillars.body: At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they believe that hope and healing are possible for everyone struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their residential treatment programs provide a safe and supportive environment for clients to focus on their recovery, with 24/7 access to addiction counsellors and regular therapy sessions. Their unique virtual rehab program allows clients to receive treatment from anywhere, with ongoing support and therapy sessions delivered through an online platform. They also offer a complimentary 30-day residential treatment program for first responders and military personnel, through their Local Heroes Support program.

pillars.title: Group and Family Programs: Supporting Addiction Recovery
pillars.body: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understands that addiction recovery is not just an individual journey, but one that impacts loved ones as well. They offer specialized group and family programs to support clients and their families throughout the recovery process. Their weekly group therapy sessions include psychoeducational skill groups, skill-based workshops, gender-specific groups, and PTSD groups for first responders. They also provide individual therapy sessions with experienced therapists who use evidence-based practices such as EMDR, CBT, and DBT. A pain management group is available for clients dealing with chronic pain, while on-site support groups for friends and family meet regularly.

pillars.title: Trafalgar’s Approach to Addiction Treatment: A Holistic and Personalized Plan
pillars.body: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understand that addiction recovery is not a one-size-fits-all approach and that each client has unique needs. They take a holistic and personalized approach to addiction treatment, utilizing evidence-based practices and experienced staff to create a plan tailored to each individual. Their comprehensive residential treatment program provides clients with access to addiction counsellors, individual therapy sessions, group therapy sessions, and wellness options. They also offer follow-up care after treatment through their alumni program and virtual aftercare program. With a focus on hope and healing, Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is committed to helping clients achieve long-term sobriety and improved mental health.

overviewH2: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres: Center Overview
overview: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is a premier private rehab center that specializes in providing unparalleled care to individuals struggling with mental health, drug and alcohol abuse. Located in beautiful Erin, Ontario, the center offers a wide range of treatment programs and therapies that cater to the unique needs of each client.

location.heading: Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres in Erin, Ontario
location.intro: Trafalgar's residence is on 13 acres of private woodland on Trafalgar Road in Erin, a rural town in Wellington County just west of the GTA. By car it's about 30 minutes west of Pearson airport (the centre's own estimate) and roughly an hour from downtown Toronto, while Guelph, Georgetown and Orangeville are around half an hour away and Brampton, Milton and Kitchener-Waterloo are within about an hour.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com estimates the cash-pay rate at $13,200 to $27,000 for 30 days of residential care. Trafalgar doesn't publish a price list on its own site, and its core program runs 42 days, so ask admissions for the total before you book. Programs are HST exempt, and the centre says the cost its intake team quotes is the full cost of programming.

faqs.q: How long is the residential program?
faqs.a: The core residential program is 42 days, and you can stay longer if the clinical team agrees you need it. Trafalgar's virtual intensive outpatient program runs for 4 or 6 weeks if you would rather get treatment from home.

Yes, withdrawal at the Erin residence is managed by Ontario-licensed physicians, and Trafalgar also runs a separate medical detox centre in Limehouse (formerly Neworld Detox). Detox there usually takes 5 to 7 days with 24-hour medical supervision, and you can move straight into residential treatment afterwards. People who have been sober for at least 72 hours before admission usually don't need further detox.

faqs.q: Where is the centre and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The residence is at 5483 Trafalgar Road in Erin, Ontario, in Wellington County. Most people arrive by car: the centre puts it about 30 minutes west of Pearson airport, and it's roughly an hour from downtown Toronto and around half an hour from Guelph, Georgetown or Orangeville. Admissions will confirm your arrival time and the packing list.

You leave with an individual discharge plan, and every Trafalgar graduate can join virtual aftercare groups led by a professional. If things get hard later, the centre says it will help you return to treatment quickly. Families can keep using the virtual Family Support Program while you settle back home.

faqs.q: Is Trafalgar covered by OHIP or private insurance?
faqs.a: No, OHIP doesn't cover it, because Trafalgar is a private, fee-for-service centre. The centre says most private insurers recognize its treatment, and staff will help you send the paperwork for a claim. Treatment is HST exempt, qualifies for the medical expense tax credit, and can be financed through Medicard.

faqs.q: Do I need a referral to be admitted?
faqs.a: No, you don't need a referral from a doctor. You must be at least 18, medically stable enough to take part, and motivated to work on your recovery. Admission starts with a free, confidential assessment call.

faqs.q: What types of addictions do you treat at Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres?
faqs.a: They treat both substance and process addictions.

faqs.q: Can you explain your local heroes support program?
faqs.a: This complimentary 30-day residential treatment program is available to first responders and military personnel.

faqs.q: What is your evidence-based approach to addiction treatment?
faqs.a: They use approaches such as EMDR, CBT, and DBT in one-on-one therapy sessions.

faqs.q: Do you offer follow-up care after residential treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, they offer follow-up care through their alumni program and virtual aftercare program.

faqs.q: How many individual therapy sessions do clients receive per week?
faqs.a: Clients receive three individual therapy sessions per week.
